name: Marching Cubes with Narrow-Band Filtering
definition: A method to reconstruct a triangle mesh from a signed distance function (SDF) by evaluating the SDF on a grid of cubes, filtering cubes based on distance to the surface (narrow-band), and applying the Marching Cubes algorithm to intersected cubes.
summary: Marching Cubes with Narrow-Band Filtering reconstructs triangle meshes from Signed Distance Functions by skipping distant cubes, significantly accelerating reconstruction for sparse or bounded volumes.
